dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've spent quite some time in Sumeru City, but ever since we last said goodbye to Lesser Lord Kusanali, we haven't heard anything from her...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* We can't just keep waiting around like this. Let's go find Katheryne and pick up some work so we can at least keep ourselves busy!
